historical_package_id: P-16 (NIR Photovoltaic Power Delivery for Implantable Devices)
created_round: R408 (external-audit instruction 4: 'Put P08 D2 through an explicit owner-decision gate')
constitutional_basis: Art. XIII (research proposes, the owner decides engineering-tradeoff questions with BUYER_DEFINED inputs)
Art. XXVII (every threshold carries provenance and class; the thermal ceiling is UNKNOWN, never invented)
Art. XXVIII (the 1.049 mW/cm2 fluence is HISTORICAL ONLY — never used to shrink this gap)
Art. LIV (the kill condition interacts with this gate: thermal infeasibility kills, in-band measurement relocates the gap here)
Art. LVI (the decision contract states what each option costs, requires, and risks)
decision_question: How does the package close the gap between the BUYER_DEFINED >= 500 uW device target and the conditional modelled band 50.5-81.4 uW on the shipped receiver at the canonical fluence?
decision_owner: OWNER (CEO) — the machine prepares this contract and refuses to pick; picking would be an engineering decision on BUYER_DEFINED inputs the machine does not own
status: OPEN — awaiting the owner decision; no option is pre-selected, none is excluded

fluence_mW_per_cm2.class: COMPUTATIONAL_RESULT_CANONICAL (R407 adjudication; committed seeded pipeline, clean-checkout byte-identical replay)

historical_fluence_mW_per_cm2.class: HISTORICAL ONLY (R310 reference-detector conversion re-labeled at R332; superseded by the R407 canonical promotion; must never be quoted as current system truth and never used to shrink this gap — at the historical fluence the gap arithmetic looks ~1.49x smaller, which is exactly why it is not used)

receiver_area_cm2.class: COMPUTATIONAL_RESULT (CAD-verified 38.4845 mm2, independently re-measured at R404)

eta_cell.note: the targeted cell's low-irradiance in-vivo-temperature efficiency is UNMEASURED — every number below is conditional on these two bounds

device_target_uW.class: BUYER_DEFINED (pre-correction '>= 500 mW' was a confirmed unit error, corrected to uW; the specific buyer derivation of the 500 figure is recorded as unknown in CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MATRIX)

gap_arithmetic.calculation: 500 / (705.0488 uW/cm2 x 0.384845 cm2 x eta) — MODEL_DERIVED from the canonical basis

eta_alone_can_never_close_it.fact: even eta = 1.0 (a physically impossible 100% cell) delivers 705.0488 x 0.384845 = 271.35 uW < 500 uW on the shipped receiver at the canonical fluence
eta_alone_can_never_close_it.consequence: the efficiency axis is a MULTIPLIER on other options, never a standalone resolution — any decision that closes D2 must move target, area, or fluence (or a combination); this is arithmetic, not judgment

options.name: Revise the device target
options.action: move the BUYER_DEFINED target from >= 500 uW to the conditional modelled band (50.5-81.4 uW under stated assumptions) or to a re-derived load requirement
options.arithmetic: none required at the current receiver/fluence — the band IS the honest modelled deliverable
requires: owner acceptance that the application value case survives at ~50-80 uW (or a recorded re-derived load requirement for the actual target device class — the specific device load is NOT currently recorded anywhere in the package)
consequences: the D2 discrepancy closes by decision record, no engineering change order
the buyer-facing claim shrinks ~6.1-9.9x versus the current target language
the package classification can proceed from GATED toward the frozen experiment without an engineering change
options.cost_class: documentation-level (no fabrication, no CAD, no re-simulation)
options.risk: if the real device class genuinely needs >= 500 uW, this option is an honest downgrade that may reduce commercial viability to zero — an owner judgment the machine cannot make

options.name: Enlarge the receiver
options.action: grow the receiver area from 0.384845 cm2 toward the required area

arithmetic.caveat: LINEAR EXTRAPOLATION — the canonical fluence was computed at the CURRENT detector-plane geometry; an enlarged receiver changes the sampled field and requires a NEW pre-registered simulation run at the new geometry (never a silent linear re-use of 0.705)

requires: owner engineering judgment on anatomical fit at the implant site for a 2.4-3.8 cm2 subcutaneous receiver (no anatomical constraint is recorded in the package — this is an owner input, not a machine fact)
a new pre-registered MC run at the new receiver geometry
updated encapsulation/optics chain (currently UNKNOWN at any area)
consequences: surgical footprint and cosmetic/anatomical acceptability change materially
fluency assumptions must be re-measured, not extrapolated
options.cost_class: CAD + simulation revision, then the same bench protocol on the new receiver
options.risk: anatomical infeasibility at the target site (owner judgment); the re-run fluence may differ from the linear estimate

options.name: Increase the source power (thermal constraints binding)
options.action: raise the external 940 nm source power above the canonical 1.0 mW input until the detector-plane fluence closes the gap

arithmetic.calculation: source scales linearly from the canonical 1.0 mW -> 0.7050488 mW/cm2 mapping (MODEL_DERIVED)
arithmetic.caveat: linear source-to-fluence scaling holds in the recorded homogeneous-phantom model; the real tissue path (skull, layered scalp — currently unquantified) may not scale linearly

requires: THE THERMAL CEILING — the thermally-permissible source power at the skin is UNKNOWN in this package: the ANSI/IEC MPE skin-exposure numbers are owner-extracted inputs (KILLABILITY_ASSESSMENT names the thermal boundary as the second kill channel with 'owner-extracted numbers required'); Art. XXVII forbids the machine inventing this threshold
the DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT's pre-registered conservative thermal limits must be re-run at the chosen source power

tissue-heating estimate: the model's absorbed fraction (~12.93% of source power in the 5 mm slab) implies ~0.79-1.28 mW absorbed at the required source powers — the temperature-rise model is NOT part of the recorded chain and needs either measurement or an owner-approved thermal model
consequences: if the required source power exceeds the thermal/MPE ceiling, the DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT falsifier (c) fires: 'the thermal envelope is violated at source powers needed for useful power (thermally infeasible)' — a KILL of the mechanism at this receiver area, not a tradeoff
source hardware class (laser/LED, driver electronics, battery life of the external unit) changes with power
options.cost_class: source hardware + bench protocol at elevated power + safety review
options.risk: the HIGHEST-stakes option: it carries the package's recorded kill channel; deciding it without the owner-extracted MPE numbers would be an Art. XXVII violation

options.name: Hybrid (recorded because real engineering decisions usually combine levers)
options.action: any combination of B + C + measured eta (option A remains the fallback for any hybrid that fails its constraints)
options.arithmetic: the levers multiply: e.g. 2x area x ~3.1x source at eta = 0.30 also reaches 500 uW — every admissible combination satisfies (area growth) x (source growth) x (eta / 0.30) >= 6.142 (best case) or 9.907 (conservative)
options.requires: the SAME owner inputs as B and C (anatomical judgment + the thermal ceiling) plus the measured eta
options.consequences: each hybrid inherits the risks of its components; none is pre-computed here — the owner names the combination and the machine re-runs the arithmetic at the named values

efficiency_axis_note: the targeted-cell low-irradiance efficiency measurement is an open input for EVERY option (it selects which conditional row applies); it cannot be the standalone resolution (see gap_arithmetic.eta_alone_can_never_close_it)
interplay_with_kill_condition: the DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT falsifier routing rule: (i) an in-band measured power (inside the pre-registered band) CONFIRMS the chain and RELOCATES the open question to exactly this gate — an engineering-tradeoff outcome, not a falsification; (ii) thermal-envelope violation at required source powers KILLS the mechanism — option C is the only option that can trigger a kill, which is why its threshold inputs are owner-extracted, never machine-invented
what_decides_this_gate: the owner's chosen option (this record exists so the choice is explicit, arithmetic-complete, and auditable)
the phantom-path bench experiment (DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT.json) — converts fluence/efficiency/thermal from modelled to measured and may shrink or grow every number in this record
the owner-extracted ANSI/IEC MPE numbers (the thermal ceiling)
the targeted-cell efficiency measurement (selects the conditional row)
presentation_rule: 0.705 mW/cm2 is the canonical fluence for every number in this gate; 1.049 mW/cm2 is historical only and appears in this record solely to be named as such; the conditional band 50.5-81.4 uW is stated with its eta assumptions everywhere it is quoted
superseded_arithmetic_disclosed: the R404-era D2 note quoted a ~4.3x area shortfall at the then-recorded fluence — that figure is historical (computed at a superseded fluence basis and a superseded band); the current arithmetic at the canonical basis is 6.1-9.9x
update_rule: when the owner decides: append the decision (chosen option, date, named values, rationale) to this record as decision_record[0]; never edit the options above — the record is append-only (Art. XI)
